magic_signatures.description: Save-valid magic u32 0xDEADD0D0 at payload base (RAM save+0xB8); compared against DAT_080012dc and re-seeded on invalid save in FUN_08001170

fields.name: save_magic
fields.description: Save-valid magic 0xDEADD0D0 at payload base (RAM save+0xB8, file logical 0xAC); baseline holds 3735933136
fields.evidence: FUN_08001170 loads 0xAC bytes via FUN_0808032c into save+0xB8, compares *(save+0xB8) to DAT_080012dc, and re-seeds it after FUN_0806ff30 memset on mismatch; file logical 0xAC bytes D0 D0 AD DE = u32 0xDEADD0D0 in baseline.

fields.name: gameplay_record_w0
fields.description: Word 0 of the persisted 0x68-byte gameplay record block (RAM save+0xBC, file logical 0xB0); baseline value 1
fields.evidence: FUN_08001414, FUN_080200fc and FUN_080206f8 memcpy the 0x68-byte record between RAM save+0x10 and save+0xBC via FUN_0807166c, then persist save+0xB8 len 0xAC via FUN_080801dc; file logical 0xB0 holds u32 1 in baseline.

fields.name: record_best
fields.description: Retained best/record value of the gameplay record (RAM save+0x14 mirrored to save+0xC0, file logical 0xB4); baseline value 100000
fields.evidence: FUN_080206f8 keeps the max of live *(save+0x04) into *(save+0x14) and persists it through the FUN_0807166c 0x68-byte save+0x10/save+0xBC mirror plus FUN_080801dc write of save+0xB8 len 0xAC; file logical 0xB4 holds u32 100000 in baseline.
